documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Intimation About Receipt Of Approval For Enhancement In Manufacturing Capacity Of Ethanol Plant
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial and operational performance for FY 2025-26, driven by growth in revenue, EBITDA, and net profit across segments like Acrylic Fibre, CPP Film, and the newly commissioned grain-based Ethanol Plant. The company successfully navigated geopolitical tensions and raw material volatility by focusing on operational efficiencies, alternate sourcing, and potential export opportunities. Despite global headwinds such as crude price fluctuations and foreign exchange volatility, management remains focused on quality, compliance, and long-term sustainable growth. Pasupati Acrylon reported an 8.03% increase in revenue from operations to Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh and a significant growth in profit after tax to Rs.

guidance.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.5% - 4.00% CAGR till 2035.
guidance.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.5% - 4.00% CAGR till 2035.

guidance.claim: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 5% CAGR till 2033.
guidance.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 5% CAGR till 2033.

guidance.claim: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.
guidance.quote: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years due to macroeconomic development of end-use sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years, particularly due to the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors which is supported by regional GDP and population growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate with rising packaging requirements across sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rising requirement for packaging across sectors, with traditional businesses preferring to package products, and the retail and e-commerce growing rapidly, the CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for packaged foods is at an all-time high due to growing world population and consumer preferences for packaged meals.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for packaged foods is at an all-time high due to growing world population. Additionally, due to concerns about sanitation and health, consumers themselves prefer packaged meals.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 4.2% CAGR till 2035.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 4.2% CAGR till 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR till 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR till 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.
demand_outlook.quote: The global ethanol market is anticipated to register a CAGR of 6.8% from 2023 to 2032.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at a 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that the sale and production declined due to lower demand during the year, but improved in the last quarter of FY 2023-24 due to better market sentiments.
demand_outlook.quote: During the year, the sale and production was declined due to lower demand but in the last quarter of FY 2023-24, it was improved due to better sentiments in the market and it is expected to improve in the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates sustained demand growth across segments, supported by India's resilient economic activity and GDP growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Your Company anticipates sustained demand growth across segments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The company applied to enhance the ethanol plant capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day and received consents from respective authorities.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequently, the Company had filed an application with the concerned departments to enhance the capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day due to improve operational efficiency and the Company has received the consents from the respective departments/ authorities in this regard.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the ethanol plant was assessed at Rs. 167 Crore, but due to cost overruns from civil work, the company spent around Rs. 188 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost was assessed Rs. 167 Crore (excluding working capital margin) but the project was overrun due to Civil work. Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the proposed 150 KLPD ethanol project is Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far on the ethanol project, including Rs. 44.08 Crores of term loan and the balance from internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil work is ongoing at the site and major orders for plant and machinery have been placed, with machine deliveries having started.
capex_expansion.quote: Civil work is going on at the site and major order for Plant & Machinery has been placed. Delivery of machines has been started.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization driven by alternate sourcing, standardization, and process improvements led to significant savings.
margins_costs.quote: Various cost optimisation driven by way of alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements and operational efficiency improvements has led significant savings.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 8.03% to Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh for financial year 2024-25 compared to Rs. 57,522.82 Lakh in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from Operations stood at Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh as against Rs. 57,522.82 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing an increase of 8.03% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: EBIDTA for the financial year 2024-25 was Rs. 5,620.09 Lakh, representing an increase of 109.31% over the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIDTA was Rs. 5,620.09 Lakh as against Rs. 2,684.93 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing an increase of 109.31% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for 2024-25 was Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh, reflecting a growth of 168.24% over the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after Tax was Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh as against Rs. 1,318.99 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing a growth of 168.24% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue and net profit declined due to lower acrylic fibre demand and negative returns on the CPP segment caused by persistent selling price falls from excessive market production capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue and Net profit during the year declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

margins_costs.claim: Loss in the CPP segment was incurred due to a persistent fall in selling prices from excessive production capacity added in the market.
margins_costs.quote: Loss of CPP segment is incurred during the year caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the company recorded Acrylic Fibre production of 35,212 MT and sales of 37,878 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,212 MT and sale of 37,878 MT, as against production of 35,198 MT and sale of 33,850 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, production and sale of CPP film was 7,545 MT and 7,621 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 7,545 MT and 7,621 MT respectively as against production and sale of 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively during the previous year with an increase of 18.95% and 18.91% in production and sales respectively over the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, production and sale of Ethanol was 41,923 KL and 41,162 KL respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of Ethanol was 41,923 KL and 41,162 KL respectively as against production and sale of 790 KL and 440 KL respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the Company recorded production of 35,198 MT and sale of 33,850 MT for acrylic fibre.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Production and sale of CPP film during the year was 6,463 MT and 6,476 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,463 MT and 6,476 MT respectively as against production of 7,663 MT and sale of 7,640 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's exports during the year were 3,044 MT compared to 4,551 MT in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year, the Company’s exports were 3,044 MT as compared to last year’s exports 4,551 MT.

capital_allocation.claim: During the year under review, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: During the year under review, the Company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, your Company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: Indian Bank sanctioned a term loan of Rs. 108 Crores, and the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 crores is to be met from internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24 as internal accruals are being used to set up the ethanol plant.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company’s internal accruals is being utilized to set-up Ethanol Plant, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global acrylic fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global Acrylic Fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Crude prices remained volatile due to the conflict in US/Israel-Iran War and Russia-Ukraine War.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in US/Israel-Iran War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has a bearing on the margin of the Company due to import dependence.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Crude price fluctuations affect raw material prices, and crude prices remained volatile due to the Israel-Hamas War and Russia-Ukraine War.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions including supply chain disruption, subdued global economic conditions, trade sanctions, intense competition, and regulatory changes are key risks exposing the company to uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geo-political tensions including supply chain disruption, subdued global economic conditions, changes in government policies and trade sanctions and restrictions, intense competition from local and global players, regulatory changes and cyber security threats are key risks which expose the Company to potential challenges and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Crude prices remained volatile during the year due to conflicts including the Israel-Hamas War and Russia-Ukraine War.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company. The market for CPP Films is primarily driven by the rapidly expanding demand from the food and beverage sector and the rising use of bags and pouches in end-use industries.

risks_headwinds.claim: The market for CPP film is moderately competitive due to the presence of multiple vendors, while stringent regulations and environmental pressures may restrain growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, the market for CPP Film Market is moderately competitive owing to the presence of multiple vendors in the market. On the other hand, stringent regulations concerning packaging, changing consumer preferences and environmental pressures may restrain the growth to some extent.

management_commitments.claim: India is successfully achieving its 20% ethanol blending target (E20).
management_commitments.quote: India has successfully achieved its 20% ethanol blending target (E20), well ahead of schedule—a major milestone in the country’s energy transition journey.

management_commitments.claim: The Company is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has exported to Dubai, Peru, Thailand, Morrocco, Tunisia, Nepal, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Brazil, Poland, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.

management_commitments.claim: The company stated that it is expected to commence commercial production of ethanol by September, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.
